_comment: LGPL components statically linked into the Bun runtime that the release exe embeds, pinned per Bun version. When bun-version in .github/workflows/release.yml changes, update every field from oven-sh/bun at the new tag: scripts/build/deps/webkit.ts (WEBKIT_VERSION) and scripts/build/deps/tinycc.ts (TINYCC_COMMIT).
